task.title: Stabilize observer channel membership for realtime websocket fanout

events.content: Treat connected+pong/no app events as observer membership scope issue: Treat connected+pong/no app events as observer membership scope issue

raw.question: Treat connected+pong/no app events as observer membership scope issue
raw.chosen: Treat connected+pong/no app events as observer membership scope issue
raw.reasoning: WebSocket transport is healthy when open and pong are present; missing message.created events indicates fanout scope mismatch (observer not joined to active channels or wrong workspace), not handshake/network failure.

retrospective.summary: Clarified that open+pong indicates healthy websocket transport and implemented observer channel-reconcile background flow so dashboard agent stays joined to all channels and receives realtime fanout.
